newsitem.title: USA: Pa. 650 MW Homer City coal unit 3 resumes output.
newsitem.headline: Pa. 650 MW Homer City coal unit 3 resumes output.

text.p: The 650 megawatt (MW) unit 3 at the Homer City coal-fired power generating complex in Pennsylvania resumed production today after being shut Friday to correct a boiler tube problem, the operator said Tuesday.
"It's been on line this morning," said a GPU Generation Inc spokesman.
Homer City's 650 MW unit 2, which was idled Sunday, is still expected to start up tomorrow, the spokesman said.
The adjoining unit 1, also about 650 MW, was running at full output, he added.
Pennsylvania Electric Co (Penelec) and New York Electric & Gas Corp each have 50 percent stake in the Homer City units.
Both Penelec and GPU Generation are subsidiaries of GPU Inc of Parsippany, New Jersey.
